name: A1
description_latex: Determine all ordered pairs of real numbers $(a,b)$ such that the line $y = ax+b$ intersects the curve $y = \ln(1+x^2)$ in exactly one point.
description_html: Determine all ordered pairs of real numbers \((a,b)\) such that the line \(y = ax+b\) intersects the curve \(y = \ln(1+x^2)\) in exactly one point.
